B_decision_clocks.the_economic_decay_question: THE question any successor must answer before any FTD form is tradable at all: does a fails balance measured 16-31 days ago still matter at decision time? Persistence of the BALANCE is measured (F6: residuals run months to years) but persistence of balance is NOT persistence of INFORMATION - the state's decision-relevant content may decay in days while the number itself lingers. Outcome-blind tests (no scored outcome needed): S1 cross-sectional rank persistence of per-name balances across successive decision instants (15-day spacing; if ranks shuffle, every per-name form is clock-dead); S2 aggregate-level autocorrelation and its correlation vs realized-vol-class series (proxy check); S3 measured books_distinct for every control (P-20); S4 deterministic PIT audit that every conditioned row's file satisfies posting_bound + guard <= t; S5 per-quarter re-measurement of the N-PORT filing-lag distribution as quarters land (57/62d is one quarter's measurement)

E_verdict_recommendation.reasoning: The plan requires PASS_DIRECT_SIGNAL_AUTHORITY only when EVERY A3 proof is PASS. F2 (per-file posting timestamps), F5 (historical CUSIP->entity mapping), and F7 (PIT denominator) are BLOCKED - the enum is foreclosed on the A3 record regardless of mechanism quality, and this dossier does not overturn any A3 ruling. BLOCKED_* verdicts would be dishonest: at least one form IS constructible today, PIT-bounded, and identity-feasible - M2 (aggregate level, zero identity and zero denominator exposure) and M1 (per-name own-level time-series under CUSIP+DESCRIPTION) are constructible as a non-scored settlement-stress conditioning/control plane under FTD_CONSERVATIVE_AVAILABILITY@1 (+15d bound, >=16d guard), with M6 (within-NPORT fund-count crowding state) constructible at quarterly-ish clocks under NPORT_SUPERSESSION@1. Direct historical scored use stays RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY; normalized forms stay UNMEASURABLE. This matches and reinforces A3's measured CONTROL_ONLY posture. The honest novelty of this dossier: (1) the within-file per-settlement-date panel structure (measured) means decision-time FTD information is 16-31 days old - the whole mechanism space is clock-gated into multi-week/quarterly horizons, and M3 flow forms are dead-on-arrival; (2) M5 event-conditioned price books are struck BY CONSTRUCTION as NG6 vol-state relabels - the single most important statement in this dossier; (3) the economic decay question (does a 16-31-day-old balance still matter at decision time) is now precisely posed with outcome-blind tests S1-S5.
E_verdict_recommendation.what_would_upgrade_to_PASS_DIRECT_SIGNAL: Exactly these owner/network-window actions, in order of mechanism impact: (1) F7 - an owner entitlement serving a PIT denominator (working per-ticker fundamentals route, or unblocked EDGAR dei with acceptance datetimes, or a licensed CUSIP-keyed daily shares/float/ADV vendor): makes M4 constructible and makes M1 cross-sectionally interpretable - the single biggest mechanism unlock; (2) F5 - an entitled historical CUSIP->entity mapping (CUSIP Global Services license or PIT mapping vendor): opens cross-source identity (FTD<->NPORT<->universe) which today is RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY; (3) F2 - per-file posting evidence captured from an unblocked network window (slow-cadence snapshots of the page listing JSON, HEAD-only, declared UA, no retry storms): lifts the conservative bound toward a measured posting schedule and makes RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY liftable for prospectively-measured availability; (4) N2 - one light EDGAR submissions/full-index fetch in an unblocked window: exact NPORT acceptance datetimes, amendment ordering resolved, UNRESOLVED_DAY_GRANULARITY ties eliminated.
